chapter: Dreamland and the Tuxedo dance hall
title: Billy Phillips and the 101 Ranch rivalry
summary: George Filhe, the Parkers and Billy Phillips arrange to move the entertainers from the 101 Ranch, and tension builds as the girls leave for the Tuxedo.
